column1: # factory/options.tsv: every option the factory has, in one place.
# This file drives four things, so it cannot drift from any of them: the onboarding prompts
# (`xal-factory init`), `xal-factory config explain`, the defaults file every seeded repo
# reads (.xal/factory.defaults, written by the seeders), and the options page of the docs.
# Gate 11 (scripts/check-options.sh) asserts every key is well-formed, every default is one
# of its choices, every key a script reads is listed here, and every key here has a reader.
#   key       dotted name, as written in .xal/factory.conf
#   default   the value when nothing sets it; `required` only where no default can exist
#   choices   `a|b|c` for a closed set, `*` for free text, `int` for a positive integer
#   scope     service (each service repo's conf) or ops (the ops repo's conf, the factory
#             profile; service-scope keys set there become the default for every new service)
#   apply     how a value takes effect: conf (read from the file), workflow:<file> (on/off
#             enables or disables that workflow), var:<NAME> (a repository variable)
#   ask       yes = `init` asks it; no = it has a sensible default and is changed later
#   what      one line: what it does
#   later     how to change it after setup

column7: what
The owner/name of the ops repo: admitted specs, the spend ledger, the idea inbox. No script can guess it.
The factory repo services vendor the spec from and the reader is pinned in. Change it only if you run a fork.
The label a stopped pull request gets when the pipeline hands it to a person.
The language `xal-factory seed` pre-selects. The service's stack ADR is still required: this is a fallback, not a decision.
The model that builds plan sessions. The strongest is the default because the gate cannot see a test that proves nothing.
The model that reads every session PR on Spec and Standards before it can merge.
Turn cap per driver run: a loop guard, not a budget.
Turn cap per reader run.
Dollar ceiling per plan, checked against the ledger before every session. Spend is bounded to ceiling + one session.
column8: xal-factory config set plan.spend_ceiling_usd <n> (applies to plans emitted after)

column7: Dollar ceiling per session across its retries.
column8: xal-factory config set plan.session_ceiling_usd <n> (applies to plans emitted after)

column7: Retries per session before it is escalated to a person.
column8: xal-factory config set plan.retry_cap <n> (applies to plans emitted after)

column7: The plugin release the reader is read from. Pinned, so an unreleased edit never changes the merge gate.
Where in the ops repo the spend ledger lives.
The driver: builds one plan session headless when dispatched (/run-session). Off means sessions are built by hand.
column8: xal-factory enable driver / xal-factory disable driver

column7: The chain: after a session merges, dispatches the next; retries a failure, then escalates. Off means every session is dispatched by a person.
column8: xal-factory enable chain / xal-factory disable chain

column7: What may merge with no person present. off disables merge.yml; the others set the plan's autonomy_level. infra, billing, public-surface and delete never merge unattended.
column8: xal-factory config set pipeline.auto_merge <level> (a plan's own autonomy_level is the owner's approval)

column7: The reader on every session PR. Auto-merge requires it.
column8: xal-factory enable reader / xal-factory disable reader

column7: @claude in issues and PRs.
column8: xal-factory enable mention / xal-factory disable mention

column7: The generic review bot on non-session PRs.
column8: xal-factory enable review / xal-factory disable review

column7: Where every workflow runs. self-hosted needs a registered runner; unset means hosted minutes.
Where deploy.yml deploys. none refuses loudly. Turning one on is a person's act (docs/deploy.md).
The live base URL the smoke gate drives after a deploy.
The weekday nudge: status/current.md rendered into a pinned issue.
column8: xal-factory enable nudge / xal-factory disable nudge

column7: The idea inbox: an open issue labelled `ideas` that /idea posts to.
